item_short_desc: The Rothco Extra-Long Insulated Gloves feature longer wrist length with drawstring bottoms to prevent water and snow from getting in. The layer of Thermoblock insulation keeps your hands warm for protection in the coldest of environments. The Extra-Long Insulated Gloves also feature adjustable straps and black leather palms.
